questions.text: When did you start losing your hair?
How did your hair loss start?
Sudden hair loss is unusual. Treatment is designed to treat the initial stages of male pattern baldness, which usually happens gradually.

questions.text: If your partner is pregnant you must use condoms while taking finasteride or Propecia to prevent harm to the baby.

questions.text: As your partner is trying to get pregnant, you should not use this medication. If you're already taking finasteride or Propecia, we recommend you stop taking it for at least 2 weeks before trying to conceive with your partner.

questions.text: I want to check your understanding of the hair loss treatment. Please tell me: You will need to take the treatment for at least 3-6 months before you see any benefit, and stopping treatment will reverse any regrowth and hair loss will resume.
The medication takes several months to work and so you won’t start to see a benefit for 3-6 months
You also need to know that these medicines can affect prostate blood test results. So if you need a prostate blood test, tell your doctor that you take finasteride or propecia.
